title: Kaikoura UFO incident

tellings.quote: there was a really big UFO incident in 1978 when I was 16 years old in a place called Kaikoura on the east coast of the South Island of New Zealand

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist from New Zealand's region, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a "really big UFO incident" happened in 1978, when he was 16, near Kaikoura on the east coast of New Zealand's South Island. He names several people he links to the case, among them John Cordy, Quentin Fogarty, Dennis Grant and Bruce Maccabee. He tells it as one of the major sightings that first drew him to the subject.
